generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
All the Terms and condition as per the Bid Document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Amount put to Tender is Excluding GST so rates Quoted Shall be Excluding GST

technicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for the award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26)The tenderer as prime contractor, should have satisfactorily completed at least one similar work such as Operation and Maintenance of Teritiary Treatment Plant (TTP) of value not less than Rs.988.92 lakh in the last five financial years

To qualify for the award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26) The tenderer should have executed in any one financial year Operational & Maintenance of 12 MLD and above capacity Tertiary Treatment Plant (TTP) based on IFAS Technology in the last five financial years meeting following effluent parameters as per Honble National Green Tribunal norms for minimum one year pH-instantaneous range -7.2-7.3,BOD5 at 20 degree C -BDL, COD less than 10mg/L, TSS less than 4 mg/L, N Total less than 10mg/l, Total Phosphorous- less than 1mg/L, Fecal Coliform less than 1 MPN/100ML

The tenderer should demonstrate Liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs.131.86 lakhs (Credit lines/letter of credit/certificates from Nationalized / Schedule banks in India for meeting the fund requirement.
